title: Laser Hair Removal vs Waxing
h1: Laser hair removal vs waxing: cost, results and comfort
desc: Laser hair removal vs waxing compared: how each works, how long results last, cost over time, ingrown hairs and who should get assessed first.
answer: Waxing pulls hair out from the root, so results last 3 to 6 weeks and must be repeated for life. Laser hair removal disables the follicle, giving long-term reduction after a course of 6 to 8 sessions, with occasional top-ups. Laser usually costs less over time and reduces ingrown hairs.
body:
## Switching from waxing to laser

Stop waxing 4 weeks before your first laser session and shave instead, because the laser needs the root in place. Read the [preparation guide](/blog/laser-hair-removal-preparation-guide/).
faq: Over a few years, usually yes, because waxing never stops.
Does laser hurt more than waxing?
Most people find laser more comfortable than waxing.
